title: campanula pusilla var. stenocodon
intro: Campanula pusilla var. stenocodon, commonly known as dwarf bellflower, is a low-growing, perennial plant species in the bellflower family. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including inflammation and respiratory issues, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant may include its ability to reduce inflammation and relieve respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents present in Campanula pusilla var. stenocodon include glycosides, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
